item.name: VirusTotal Get Objects Related to a Comment

request.description:
Comment objects are related to other objects in the Google Threat Intelligence dataset. As mentioned in the Relationships section, those related objects can be retrieved by sending `GET` requests to the relationships endpoint.

All available relationships are documented in the Comment API object page.
